definitions.gloss: rear-end collision; running into the back of another vehicle
definitions.explanation: A traffic accident where one vehicle crashes into the back of the vehicle ahead of it. One of the most common types of traffic accidents.

examples.japanese: {信号待|しんごうま}ちの{車|くるま}に{追突|ついとつ}された。
examples.english: I was rear-ended while waiting at a traffic light.

examples.japanese: {高速道路|こうそくどうろ}で{追突|ついとつ}{事故|じこ}が{発生|はっせい}した。
examples.english: A rear-end collision occurred on the expressway.

examples.japanese: {車間距離|しゃかんきょり}を{十分|じゅうぶん}に{取|と}らないと{追突|ついとつ}の{危険|きけん}がある。
examples.english: If you don't maintain enough distance between cars, there is a risk of a rear-end collision.

notes:
USAGE:
A common term in traffic news and accident reports. The driver who rear-ends another vehicle is typically considered at fault in Japan. Chain rear-end collisions ({玉突|たまつ}き{事故|じこ}) involving multiple vehicles are also discussed using this term.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {追突|ついとつ}{事故|じこ} (rear-end collision accident)
- {追突|ついとつ}する (to rear-end)
- {追突|ついとつ}される (to be rear-ended)
- {追突|ついとつ}を{防|ふせ}ぐ (to prevent a rear-end collision)
